title: Restrict the waypoint follower to the training command bank
summary: WaypointFollower now emits only omniwalk bank entries or stand: it holds the body heading at a multiple of 45 degrees, turns at the bank yaw rate when the heading passes a gate, and otherwise drives holonomically along the bank bearing nearest the goal at the nearest bank speed. The default envelope is derived from the bank. The navigation tests drive an eight-connected staircase route at 50 Hz and assert every command is a bank entry, the route completes, and the heading stays within the gate; a test asserts the navigation-side bank equals the locomotion command bank.
next: Connect the follower to the grid route planner and evaluate a planned route against the admitted checkpoint.
reason: The change is CPU navigation code and tests. Runtime locomotion sources, checkpoint bytes, the approved robot, acceptance gates and roadmap markers remain unchanged.
